name: Maw of the Void
summary: The Maw of the Void is a violent, churning whirlpool located in Darkshore that swallows draining waters from across the region. Plunging into its roaring vortex pulls travelers deep beneath the earth into the cavernous Bashal'Aran Collapse. In recent days, the site has drawn dangerous attention from water elementals and sinister cultists.

sections.title: The Churning Abyss
sections.body: Situated southeast of Lor'danel, the Maw of the Void is a terrifying natural maelstrom where regional runoff, including the torrents of the Cliffspring River, empties into an abyss. Rather than battering swimmers against rocks, the vortex acts as a subterranean siphon, plunging anyone brave or foolish enough to leap inside safely down into the subterranean ruins of the Bashal'Aran Collapse. However, unrest has surrounded the vortex as violent water elementals stir, drawing dark opportunists from the Twilight's Hammer who seek to harness the chaotic aquatic forces.

faq.q: What happens if I jump into the Maw of the Void?
faq.answer: Plunging into the center of the vortex sucks you downward in a fierce rush of water, depositing you safely at the bottom of the cavernous Bashal'Aran Collapse without suffering fall damage.

faq.q: Where does the water draining into the whirlpool come from?
faq.answer: Much of the zone's drainage flows directly into the abyss, most notably the runoff carrying down from the Cliffspring River.

faq.q: Who is occupying the area around the vortex?
aliases: who is at maw of the void
faq.answer: The whirlpool is swarming with agitated water elementals, including the powerful Hydrath, alongside Twilight's Hammer cultists like Twilight Enforcers and Wavebreakers who have claimed the surrounding shores.

faq.q: Where does the Maw lead once you fall through?
faq.answer: The whirlpool washes you directly into the subterranean depths known as the Bashal'Aran Collapse, an ancient cavern buried beneath the ruins of the surface.

angles.text: The chaotic water elementals gathering around the Maw indicate grave unrest among the spirits of Darkshore, particularly with cultists bending the elements to their will.
The corruption and disruption around ancient ruins like Bashal'Aran and its draining waters threaten the fragile balance of Darkshore.
